about: Provenance and the defect-check verdict for every image under public/oh/img/. Products are written by scripts/demo-kit/fetch-imagery.mjs from scripts/demo-kit/configs/oh/imagery.json: LG's own product images from LG's media host, one hero per product, crop, scale and ground only. "large" holds 840-pixel renditions of the products the campaign art places, from the same sources. "art" is Lane A1's. A verdict holds only for the sha256 it was given to; a changed file reads pending. "unfetched" lists the products without an image; they render placeholder-product.svg, a generated placeholder. index.json maps each sku to its entry. No OH page carries an LG mark of its own; LG's marks on its products are part of the product.

art.about: OH campaign art (Lane A1), written by scripts/generate-oh-art.mjs from scripts/demo-kit/configs/oh/art.json. Each file is a generated scene (no product, no text, no marks) with the piece's lead product placed on it from LG's own cutout in products/, or a composed gradient where no scene was generated; provenance per row, each scene's exact prompt once under prompts by the id its row names. Three encodings: WebP (the src), AVIF and a JPEG fallback; opaque art carries no transparency, so the kit's transparent PNG is not made. The verdict holds only for the sha256 of the exact WebP reviewed. art/index.json maps each piece to its files.
art.tone: light: The art in lg.com's tone, daylight and colour. Every scene is a sunlit, lived-in room (living rooms, laundry rooms, kitchens) in warm saturated colour, or a colour-lit studio set in daylight, measured to land near lg.com's own hero (mean luma about 110 to 140 on the art half, a sixth to a quarter of the pixels darker than 60); the products are placed at exactly A1's scale (art.json's boxes and shrinks). Slides and banners carry no scrim, because the page sets dark type on its own white panel there (M1c); deal tiles and tall tiles keep a shaded foot for their white headlines; room tiles carry their text under the picture, so no scrim.
art.config: scripts/demo-kit/configs/oh/art.json, tone light (tones.light over the base keys)
art.text: none baked in: headline, sub, badge and button are content the page draws over the art

prompts.p-e29f9976c4: A sunlit modern living room in the late afternoon: warm terracotta-clay limewashed walls, golden late-afternoon sunlight streaming in from a tall window out of frame at the left and washing across the back wall in a warm amber glow with soft window-pane light patterns, a low walnut-and-oak media console along the floor at the right, a warm oak floor with a woven rug.
